description: This file defines mock classes and methods for GSSAPI library used in unit testing, including a mock implementation of GSSAPI context and library functions, with focus on POSIX systems.

classes.description: Mock implementation of GSSAPI context for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockGSSAPILibrary
classes.description: Mock class for GSSAPI library used in unit tests, allowing expectation setting and simulation of GSSAPI calls.

classes.name: SecurityContextQuery
classes.description: Structure representing expected security context query parameters and responses for testing.

methods.description: Constructors and destructor for mock GSSAPI context.
